label: opened: the scene, the outline, the kit's library, the scene filling the frame
eval: (() => { const s = __scene; const eng = s.vp.engine(); return JSON.stringify({ scene: s.state.scene, rows: [...document.querySelectorAll('#outline .row')].map(r => r.textContent.trim()), library: !!s.state.library, meshes: eng && eng.census().meshes, focused: !!s.vp.sceneEl()?.hasAttribute('data-tk-focus'), selected: s.state.sel }); })()
expect: r => r.meshes === 12 && r.library && r.focused && r.rows.length === 10 && r.selected.id === 'scene'

label: click the robot's body in the view
the body is selected: outline row, inspector title, box drawn
eval: JSON.stringify({ sel: __scene.state.sel, row: document.querySelector('#outline .row.sel')?.textContent.trim(), title: document.querySelector('.insp-title input')?.value, boxes: __scene.vp.helpers.length })

label: colour from a swatch: live, no rebuild (the same frame)
the body's material is the swatch's colour, and the frame is the same one
eval: (() => { let c; __scene.vp.engine().scene.traverse(o => { if (o.userData?.nodeId === 'robotBody' && o.material) c = '#' + o.material.color.getHexString(); }); return JSON.stringify({ colour: c, param: __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robotBody').parameters.colour, sameFrame: __scene.vp.frame === __f0, dirty: __scene.model.dirtyKeys() }); })()
expect: r => r.colour === r.param && r.sameFrame === true && r.dirty.length === 1

label: drag the body 160 px right (inside its group)
the body moved: params and the object
eval: (() => { const p = __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robotBody').parameters; const c = __scene.vp.engine().census().objects.find(o => o.node === 'robotBody'); return JSON.stringify({ before: [__b0.x, __b0.z], after: [p.x, p.z], object: [c.x, c.z].map(v => +v.toFixed(2)), sameFrame: __scene.vp.frame === __f0 }); })()

label: select the robot in the outline, then press on its head and drag: the group moves, the head stays put in it
eval: (() => { document.querySelector('#outline .row[data-node=robot]').click(); window.__r0 = { ...__scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robot').parameters }; window.__h0 = { ...(__scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robotHead').parameters) }; return JSON.stringify({ sel: __scene.state.sel, robot: [__r0.x ?? 0, __r0.z ?? 0], boxes: __scene.vp.helpers.length }); })()

label: robot moved, head's own params unchanged, still the robot selected
eval: (() => { const r = __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robot').parameters; const hd = __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robotHead').parameters; return JSON.stringify({ sel: __scene.state.sel.id, robot: [__r0.x ?? 0, __r0.z ?? 0, '->', r.x, r.z], headSame: JSON.stringify(hd) === JSON.stringify(__h0) }); })()

label: one undo takes the whole group drag back
eval: (() => { __scene.undo(); const r = __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','robot').parameters; return JSON.stringify({ robot: [r.x ?? 0, r.z ?? 0] }); })()

label: add a box from the palette
the box is in the scene, the files, the outline, selected
add a group, then drag the box into it in the outline (model call)
eval: (() => { const s = __scene; const box = s.state.sel.id; s.addTile('group'); const g = s.state.sel.id; s.model.reparent('Pages/Home', box, g); window.__ids = { box, g }; return JSON.stringify(window.__ids); })()

label: the box is inside the group in the scene graph
undo three times: the reparent, the group, then not the box
click empty space: the scene is selected

eval: JSON.stringify({ sel: __scene.state.sel, title: document.querySelector('.insp-title input')?.value, sections: [...document.querySelectorAll('.sect h4')].map(e => e.textContent) })
label: an empty click selects the Scene
orbit by dragging empty space, then Use this view

eval: (() => { const v = __scene.vp.view(); __scene.useThisView(); const p = __scene.model.node('Pages/Home','scene').parameters; return JSON.stringify({ before: __cam0.angle, after: v.angle, saved: [p.cameraDistance, p.cameraHeight, p.cameraAngle] }); })()

save
